sources.title: Maxilicious20/Echo-Vision-1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A two-stage coarse-to-fine latent diffusion model (rectified flow), trained entirely from scratch on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4060, 8 GB VRAM). Echo-Vision-1 generates 768×768 images by first "sketching" a low-resolution draft of the scene and then refining it into a high-resolution image with a dedicated super-resolution-style diffusion stage.
